summarization:
This smartphone UI screen appears to be part of a language learning app. The main content includes a multiple-choice question asking the user to "Select 'people'." There are four options presented with images and corresponding Chinese characters and pinyin:

1. An image of water with the text "水 / shuǐ."
2. An image of people with the text "人 / rén."
3. An image of the sky with the text "天 / tiān."
4. An image of a whale with the text "大 / dà."

At the bottom of the screen, there is a "CHECK" button for the user to submit their answer. The top of the screen shows a score of "0" and some icons, likely representing lives or attempts remaining. The time is displayed in the top right corner.
